name: Ujaku
source:
The proprietress of the brothel ”Yukishiro.” Used to be a prostitute of Yoshiwara, but is currently retired, dealing with the management side of things instead.

She’s always been prone to look after others, and so many people in Ueno rely on her as the manager of Ueno’s brothels that she’s always busy.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=116]MangaGamer[/url]]
